pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 in staged patches. This first dispatcher request adds persisted model-owned humanoid profile metadata, portable humanoid semantics, pure Native-to-Humanoid conversion, target-bound Humanoid baking, structural validation/detection, and Derived Cache keying. Follow-up requests on the same Draft PR wire import cataloging, Animation Set source selection, editor configuration, and packaging/runtime resolution.
